study type: Longitudinal cohort study (for VPT infants) with cross-sectional comparisons (to FT infants)
exposure: Early stay in neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: The study included 56 very preterm (VPT) infants and 27 full-term (FT) infants.
finding: Lower PLAGL1 methylation was observed in very preterm infants at birth and discharge compared to full-term infants at birth.
followup_time: Until neonatal intensive care unit discharge
cross-section timing: At birth, and at neonatal intensive care unit discharge for VPT infants compared to FT infants at birth.
